question: Should Telegram suppress all compaction-notice and system-glyph payloads at the adapter boundary, or preserve the current user-visible notice contract and require a narrower typed suppression signal?
rationale: The patch changes a documented config-controlled delivery contract and a shared visible text convention, so the permanent suppression boundary is a product/delivery policy choice rather than a routine code cleanup.

options.title: Preserve Current Delivery Contract
options.body: Remove the unconditional compaction-notice suppression and require any unwanted Telegram-only notice to use typed metadata or a narrow classifier.

options.title: Approve Broad Telegram Suppression
options.body: Accept that Telegram will hide all compaction notices and system-glyph text, then update docs/tests and own the compatibility break.

options.title: Pause Until Reframed
options.body: Leave the PR open but ask for a concrete unwanted-notice reproduction and a narrower patch before further review.

recommendation.title: Preserve Current Delivery Contract
recommendation.body: Remove the unconditional compaction-notice suppression and require any unwanted Telegram-only notice to use typed metadata or a narrow classifier.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner has the strongest recent history on the related compaction delivery repair and can compare the PR against the merged delivery contract.
